title: Mack Trident FUPS compliant Custom High Tensile Aluminium Bullbar #22
description: Mack Trident Fwd F/axle FUPS Bullbar. 88mm dia pipe, 100mm dia available. Indicator and daytime running lights in channel. Custom driving light mounts to customer requirements. The centre light bar will accommodate a LED Light Bar. Full length box uprights for maximum protection. Dual Dangerous Goods signs, cowcatcher and 4 small uprights. High tensile aluminium backing plate with 38mm tow pin. Bull bar can be custom built to your requirements.
